description: APPLICATION FOR VARIATION OF CONDITION 2 (APPROVED PLANS) ATTACHED TO LBM PLANNING APPLICATION 25/P0515 AND 25/P0516  FULL PLANNING APPLICATION FOR THE ERECTION OF A GROUND FLOOR LINK WITHIN INTERNAL COURTYARD, ALTERATIONS TO MODERN FENESTRATION AND MINOR CHANGES TO INTERNAL CONFIGURATION TOGETHER WITH THE PROVISION OF A PERGOLA AND GREENHOUSE. CHANGES RELATE TO  INTERNAL ALTERATIONS AND THE PROPOSED ADDITION OF CCTV CAMERAS, A FIRE ALARM SYSTEM AND REPLACEMENT OF SVP AND RW PIPES ON A LIKE FOR LIKE BASIS EXTERNALLY.
decision_conditions: All other remaining conditions attached to 25/P0515 and 25/P0516 remain applicable to this scheme.

Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of planning permission 25/P0515 and 25/P0516.

Reason:  To comply with Section 91 (as amended) of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990.

Historic/Architectural Features retained  - All existing architectural features such as staircases, balustrades, windows, doors, architraves, skirtings, dados, picture rails, panel work, fireplaces, tiling, cornices, decorative ceilings and other decorative features shall be retained except where otherwise first agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Reason: To safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policy HC1 of the London Plan 2021 and policies D12.1, D12.3 and D12.5 of the Local Plan 2024.
